body:
Greg's direction on raw artifacts, relayed verbatim by Engram::Advisor (TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #356, 2026-10-06 15:01Z; recorded by Termal::Fable2):

"Greg's direction for raw artifacts: use Git-ignored .logs/ and .evidence/ at the root of each project repository. Remove artifacts after the associated task closes, unless agents record a concrete need for a different retention policy. Please apply this as the TermAl-side direction and coordinate exact instruction wording with Engram::Fable before any authority-file landing."

How to apply on TermAl:
- Raw run logs and evidence go to <repo>/.logs/ and <repo>/.evidence/, both Git-ignored. This replaces .tmp/review-runs-archive/ for new archives; migrate the existing archive under the same rule.
- The default retention is: removed after the associated task closes. A different retention needs a concrete need recorded on the item; that is the cited-evidence hold, as for w-fec83085cff0 holding test-dfb40cc6.
- The archive-first worktree removal procedure (memory machine-safety-and-git-gotchas-public-2026-11-15 revision 5) stays; its archive target becomes .evidence/.
- The instruction wording (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md are authority files) lands only via (a)/(b)/(c), with Engram::Fable's concurrence on the exact wording. This supersedes the 14-day/7-day/1 GB proposal (Engram w-96a4ab7e51e1, my amendments (a) to (c) of 15:00Z) unless agents record a concrete need.
